source: AeroNav charts for Perth Intl (aeronav.space), read from the charts' text. Fix names only; positions come from 24SPY via scripts/build-navdata.js. Fixes missing from 24SPY are listed in the plan response as unplaced.
note: Runway keys can be lists ("11,15"). A leg {fix, min/max/at} is an altitude restriction in feet. 'vectors' means the chart ends the procedure with radar vectors rather than a fix.

initial.11: Climb on heading 111 to intercept course 090 to NOONU.
initial.29: Climb on heading 291 to 600, then climbing left turn direct STRAX.
initial.33: Climb on heading 331 to intercept course 241 to TINDR.

initial.11,15,29,33: Climb on the runway's published climb (island / orange / haven climbs) then radar vectors to the assigned route; maintain 3000.

stars.name: SISTA2
stars.title: SISTA 2 RNAV ARRIVAL
stars.notes: Expect radar vectors to NOONU for the VOR approach, or an earlier RNAV approach at TALIS if traffic allows.

approaches.name: ILS OR LOC RWY 11
approaches.missed: Climb runway heading to 500, climbing left turn to 1500 direct PER VOR and hold.

approaches.name: LDA Z RWY 29
approaches.missed: Turn direct PER VOR and climb to 1000, then PER R240 outbound to 1500, at 8.8 DME turn direct ORG VOR and hold.
approaches.notes: The PHxxx fixes are IPTH DME fixes on the chart and have no 24SPY position.

approaches.name: LDA Y RWY 29
approaches.missed: Turn direct PER VOR and climb to 1000, then PER R240 outbound to 1500, at 8.8 DME turn direct ORG VOR and hold.

approaches.name: RNAV (RNP) Z RWY 29
approaches.missed: Climb on heading 290 to 500, then climbing left turn to 2000 direct PER VOR and hold.
approaches.notes: RNP AR - authorization required. RF legs.

approaches.name: GLS RWY 33
approaches.missed: Climb runway heading until 500, then continue climb to 2000 direct BTM and hold.
approaches.notes: How the initial fixes join QUAKE/STOPR is not captured.
